meta.defaults: tailwind v4: type scale, spacing, shadows (inherited, per the docs pages); radius: preset b5cR4Y50S base-nova, but xs (inherited, per the Radius page)

usage.foreground: Default text and icons on `background`, `card`, `popover` and `muted` (`text-foreground`).
usage.card: Card surface, one step off `background`. Text on it: `foreground`.
usage.card-foreground: Text and icons on `card`; the same role as `foreground`.
usage.popover: Popover, dropdown and menu surface. Text on it: `foreground`.
usage.popover-foreground: Text and icons on `popover`; the same role as `foreground`.
usage.primary: Primary actions: default button fill, links, active states (`bg-primary`). Text on it: `primary-foreground`.
usage.secondary: Secondary button fill. This is the MD3 secondary *container*, not `md-sys-color-secondary`. Text on it: `secondary-foreground`.
usage.muted: Muted fill: skeletons, inactive tabs, subtle panels. Text on it: `foreground` or `muted-foreground`.
usage.muted-foreground: Lower-emphasis text (captions, placeholders, help text) on `background`, `card`, `popover` and `muted`.
usage.accent: Hover and selected fill of menu items and ghost buttons. Same role as `secondary`. Text on it: `accent-foreground`.
usage.destructive: Destructive actions and error states. As a fill, put `md-sys-color-on-error` on it.
usage.border: Decorative dividers and container borders. Too faint to carry meaning alone; use `input` for control boundaries.
usage.input: Borders of inputs and other controls, on `background` and `card`.
usage.chart-{n}: Chart series {n}. Same value in light and dark.
usage.sidebar: Sidebar surface; same role as `card`. Text on it: `foreground`.
usage.sidebar-foreground: Text and icons on `sidebar`; the same role as `foreground`.
usage.sidebar-primary: Primary fill inside the sidebar; follows `primary`.
usage.sidebar-accent: Hover and selected fill inside the sidebar; follows `accent`.
usage.sidebar-ring: Focus ring inside the sidebar; follows `ring`.
usage.md-sys-color-background: Page background. Same value as `md-sys-color-surface`. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-background`.
usage.md-sys-color-error: Errors and destructive actions; seeded from the brand red `#ff4980`. High-emphasis fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-error`.
usage.md-sys-color-error-container: Lower-emphasis error fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-error-container`.
usage.md-sys-color-inverse-surface: Surface that contrasts with the scheme (snackbars, tooltips). Text on it: `md-sys-color-inverse-on-surface`.
usage.md-sys-color-on-surface: Default text and icons on every `md-sys-color-surface*` role; shadcn `foreground`.
usage.md-sys-color-on-surface-variant: Lower-emphasis text and icons on every `md-sys-color-surface*` role; shadcn `muted-foreground`.
usage.md-sys-color-outline: Boundaries that carry meaning (input borders) on surface roles; shadcn `input`.
usage.md-sys-color-outline-variant: Decorative dividers on surface roles; shadcn `border`.
usage.md-sys-color-primary: The main accent, computed from the poimandres lime seed `#caf543`. High-emphasis fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-primary`.
usage.md-sys-color-primary-container: Lower-emphasis primary fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-primary-container`.
usage.md-sys-color-primary-fixed: Primary fill that keeps the same value in light and dark. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-primary-fixed`, `md-sys-color-on-primary-fixed-variant`.
usage.md-sys-color-primary-fixed-dim: Dimmer fixed primary fill, same value in light and dark. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-primary-fixed`, `md-sys-color-on-primary-fixed-variant`.
usage.md-sys-color-scrim: Scrim behind modals, applied with opacity. Black in both schemes.
usage.md-sys-color-secondary: Generated by MD3 from the seed; intentionally unused as an accent, the named brand colours take its place. High-emphasis fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-secondary`.
usage.md-sys-color-secondary-container: Lower-emphasis secondary fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-secondary-container`.
usage.md-sys-color-secondary-fixed: Secondary fill that keeps the same value in light and dark. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-secondary-fixed`, `md-sys-color-on-secondary-fixed-variant`.
usage.md-sys-color-secondary-fixed-dim: Dimmer fixed secondary fill, same value in light and dark. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-secondary-fixed`, `md-sys-color-on-secondary-fixed-variant`.
usage.md-sys-color-shadow: Shadow colour. Black in both schemes.
usage.md-sys-color-surface-container: Default container surface. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-surface`.
usage.md-sys-color-surface-container-high: High-emphasis container; shadcn `popover`. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-surface`.
usage.md-sys-color-surface-container-highest: Highest-emphasis container; shadcn `muted`. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-surface`.
usage.md-sys-color-surface-container-low: Low-emphasis container; shadcn `card` and `sidebar`. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-surface`.
usage.md-sys-color-surface-container-lowest: Lowest-emphasis container surface. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-surface`.
usage.md-sys-color-surface-dim: Dimmest surface (`bg-surface-dim`), a role shadcn has no name for; the Keypoints panel sits on it. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-surface`.
usage.md-sys-color-surface-tint: Tint colour for elevation overlays; same shade as `md-sys-color-primary`.
usage.md-sys-color-surface-variant: Alternate surface from the neutral-variant palette. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`.
usage.md-sys-color-tertiary: Generated by MD3 from the seed; intentionally unused as an accent, the named brand colours take its place. High-emphasis fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-tertiary`.
usage.md-sys-color-tertiary-container: Lower-emphasis tertiary fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-tertiary-container`.
usage.md-sys-color-tertiary-fixed: Tertiary fill that keeps the same value in light and dark. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-tertiary-fixed`, `md-sys-color-on-tertiary-fixed-variant`.
usage.md-sys-color-tertiary-fixed-dim: Dimmer fixed tertiary fill, same value in light and dark. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-tertiary-fixed`, `md-sys-color-on-tertiary-fixed-variant`.
usage.md-sys-color-lime: Brand colour lime (seed `#caf543`, not blended). Also the primary source seed. High-emphasis fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-lime`.
usage.md-sys-color-lime-container: Lower-emphasis lime fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-lime-container`.
usage.md-sys-color-teal: Brand colour teal (seed `#00f7a3`, not blended). High-emphasis fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-teal`.
usage.md-sys-color-teal-container: Lower-emphasis teal fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-teal-container`.
usage.md-sys-color-cyan: Brand colour cyan (seed `#2bdcf6`, not blended). High-emphasis fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-cyan`.
usage.md-sys-color-cyan-container: Lower-emphasis cyan fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-cyan-container`.
usage.md-sys-color-purple: Brand colour purple (seed `#d855f9`, not blended). High-emphasis fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-purple`.
usage.md-sys-color-purple-container: Lower-emphasis purple fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-purple-container`.
usage.md-sys-color-red: Brand colour red (seed `#ff4980`, not blended). Also drives the error role. High-emphasis fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-red`.
usage.md-sys-color-red-container: Lower-emphasis red fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-red-container`.
usage.md-sys-color-orange: Brand colour orange (seed `#ffc043`, not blended). High-emphasis fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-orange`.
usage.md-sys-color-orange-container: Lower-emphasis orange fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-orange-container`.
usage.md-sys-color-yellow: Brand colour yellow (seed `#ebff0f`, not blended). High-emphasis fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-yellow`.
usage.md-sys-color-yellow-container: Lower-emphasis yellow fill. Text on it: `md-sys-color-on-yellow-container`.
usage.md-ref-palette-primary-{tone}: Tone {tone} of the primary tonal palette. Reference shade, same in both schemes: build with the `md-sys-color-*` roles that alias it, not with this directly.
usage.md-ref-palette-secondary-{tone}: Tone {tone} of the secondary tonal palette. Reference shade, same in both schemes: build with the `md-sys-color-*` roles that alias it, not with this directly.
usage.md-ref-palette-tertiary-{tone}: Tone {tone} of the tertiary tonal palette. Reference shade, same in both schemes: build with the `md-sys-color-*` roles that alias it, not with this directly.
usage.md-ref-palette-error-{tone}: Tone {tone} of the error tonal palette. Reference shade, same in both schemes: build with the `md-sys-color-*` roles that alias it, not with this directly.
usage.md-ref-palette-neutral-{tone}: Tone {tone} of the neutral tonal palette. Reference shade, same in both schemes: build with the `md-sys-color-*` roles that alias it, not with this directly.
usage.md-ref-palette-neutral-variant-{tone}: Tone {tone} of the neutral-variant tonal palette. Reference shade, same in both schemes: build with the `md-sys-color-*` roles that alias it, not with this directly.
usage.md-ref-palette-lime-{tone}: Tone {tone} of the lime brand tonal palette. Reference shade, same in both schemes: build with the `md-sys-color-*` roles that alias it, not with this directly.
usage.md-ref-palette-teal-{tone}: Tone {tone} of the teal brand tonal palette. Reference shade, same in both schemes: build with the `md-sys-color-*` roles that alias it, not with this directly.
usage.md-ref-palette-cyan-{tone}: Tone {tone} of the cyan brand tonal palette. Reference shade, same in both schemes: build with the `md-sys-color-*` roles that alias it, not with this directly.
usage.md-ref-palette-purple-{tone}: Tone {tone} of the purple brand tonal palette. Reference shade, same in both schemes: build with the `md-sys-color-*` roles that alias it, not with this directly.
usage.md-ref-palette-red-{tone}: Tone {tone} of the red brand tonal palette. Reference shade, same in both schemes: build with the `md-sys-color-*` roles that alias it, not with this directly.
usage.md-ref-palette-orange-{tone}: Tone {tone} of the orange brand tonal palette. Reference shade, same in both schemes: build with the `md-sys-color-*` roles that alias it, not with this directly.
usage.md-ref-palette-yellow-{tone}: Tone {tone} of the yellow brand tonal palette. Reference shade, same in both schemes: build with the `md-sys-color-*` roles that alias it, not with this directly.

usage.text-xs: Captions, badges, fine print. Tailwind default `text-xs`.
usage.text-sm: Default UI text in shadcn components: buttons, inputs, labels, menus. Tailwind default `text-sm`.
usage.text-lg: Lead paragraphs, card titles. Tailwind default `text-lg`.
usage.text-5xl: Display sizes for hero and marketing headlines. Tailwind default `text-5xl`.
usage.text-6xl: Display sizes for hero and marketing headlines. Tailwind default `text-6xl`.
usage.text-7xl: Display sizes for hero and marketing headlines. Tailwind default `text-7xl`.
usage.text-8xl: Display sizes for hero and marketing headlines. Tailwind default `text-8xl`.
usage.text-9xl: Display sizes for hero and marketing headlines. Tailwind default `text-9xl`.
usage.code-inline: Inline code, shadcn's recipe: `font-mono text-sm font-semibold` on `bg-muted`. `code`, `kbd`, `samp` and `pre` are Inconsolata without a class.

spacing.note: Inherited from Tailwind v4 defaults, not yet a pmndrs decision (the Spacing page of the docs). Every step is a multiple of `spacing`.

usage.spacing: The base unit, `--spacing`: utility `n` is `n × 0.25rem`, so any multiple works (`p-13` is `3.25rem`). Tailwind v4 default.
usage.spacing-{step}: Tailwind default step {step} ({pixels}): `p-{step}`, `gap-{step}`, `size-{step}`. Every step is a multiple of the 0.25rem base.

radius.note: A pmndrs decision: one base, `radius` (0.625rem), and the preset's base-nova scale multiplying it (the Radius page of the docs), but `radius-xs`, inherited from Tailwind. Values at a 16px root.

usage.radius: The base radius, `--radius`: a pmndrs decision, from the preset `b5cR4Y50S` (style `base-nova`, radius `default`). Every `rounded-sm` to `rounded-4xl` step is a multiple of it; change it and every corner rescales.
usage.radius-xs: Tailwind default `rounded-xs`, outside the base-nova scale: inherited, as the Radius page notes, a fixed value that does not follow `radius`.

shadow.note: Inherited from Tailwind v4 defaults, not yet a pmndrs decision (the Shadows page of the docs). Black at low opacity in both schemes.

usage.inset-shadow-2xs: Recessed surfaces, the lightest. Tailwind default `inset-shadow-2xs`; stacks with `shadow-*`.
usage.inset-shadow-xs: Recessed surfaces. Tailwind default `inset-shadow-xs`; stacks with `shadow-*`.
usage.inset-shadow-sm: Recessed surfaces, the deepest. Tailwind default `inset-shadow-sm`; stacks with `shadow-*`.

dropShadow.note: `filter: drop-shadow()` values, for shapes that are not boxes: icons, SVGs, cut-out images. Inherited from Tailwind v4 defaults, not yet a pmndrs decision (the Shadows page of the docs).

usage.drop-shadow-{step}: Tailwind default `drop-shadow-{step}`: follows the painted shape, transparent pixels excluded.
